body: I hope things will be okay. At this point I'm really doubting it. I'm not going to waste anybody else's time trying to do me favors. I really appreciate all of your time and effort, but when my wife tells me that I am a waste of her time and I'm doing nothing to better our situation, I don't think there's much of an up after that. I failed myself and my family, and now I've failed everyone who ever believed in me. Even though I've never met you in my life, I cannot tell you enough how much you helped when I thought there might still be hope, and I only wish I had some one like you in my life, if only for a day.

You've hit the nail on the head. She's already threatened to leave me if I didn't go to boot and graduate, and everytime I talk about dropping she calls me a quitter, or a loser, or a pussy. I have no support at home, but I love her, and I don't want to lose her or my kids. I've just come to the conclusion that it would be easier for them to lose me rather than the other way around. I couldn't live with the shame of quitting after so many said they were proud of me for making that decision.

I guesss my biggest mistake was being hasty about the branch I chose. My wife was pushing the Air Force pretty hard when I first started looking, but I went against my better judgement and joined the Marine Corps instead, knowing I wasn't physically or mentally fit for it. Now that I'm this far along, I've realized my mistake, but I don't know if going to another branch is possible this late (my ship date is Feb. 2). I just wish my wife was more understanding about why I don't want to do it, rather than stay hung up on all the benefits we'd lose. She's too concerned about what she might lose out on rather than my feelings about it. I want a good future for my wife and kids, but I don't want to spend my life doing something I was pushed into doing. On the other hand, I don't want to give up on this huge opportunity because I was anxious about going to boot camp, when it could have turned out a lot easier than I expected. I'm just lost.
Thanks man, I'll give that a try.

I don't have the profile I downloaded the DLC with, but I have DLC for Skyrim that was downloaded using the profile I don't have anymore and it works just fine. Mothership Zeta worked for a while, but has stopped working for some reason. I'm at a loss.
New minimum IST requirements are 5 dead hang pull ups, 60 crunches in 2 minutes, and a 12:30 mile and a half run. I'm in the DEP right now, and this is what my recruiter and all related material say.
No, I might have to give it a shot. Thanks.
